name: Marshal Haggard's Badge
summary: Marshal Haggard's Badge is a symbol of rank and authority once carried by Marshal Haggard during his service to the kingdom of Stormwind. After being stolen by the Defias bandit Dead-tooth Jack through trickery, the badge poses a dangerous threat as a tool for impersonating city officials.

sections.title: A Stolen Insignia
sections.body: Though Marshal Haggard has long retired to his small farmstead in the hills of Elwynn Forest, his old Stormwind Marshal's badge still holds official weight. Under the cover of night, a Defias rogue named Dead-tooth Jack donned a Stormwind tabard and posed as Marshal Dughan, Goldshire's garrison commander. Tricked into believing his former peers required the insignia for official business, the aging Haggard handed it over without suspicion. Jack fled into the woods before the retired officer realized the ruse. In the hands of the Defias Brotherhood, such an emblem of Stormwind authority could allow outlaws to slip past checkpoints or sow confusion among local patrols.

faq.answer: It is an official insignia of rank from Marshal Haggard's time serving the kingdom of Stormwind. Even in retirement, retaining such a badge signifies past military standing and carries genuine authority.

faq.q: How did Dead-tooth Jack get the badge?
faq.answer: Dead-tooth Jack approached Marshal Haggard's home under cover of darkness wearing a Stormwind tabard. In the dim light, Haggard mistook him for Goldshire's Marshal Dughan and handed over the badge when asked.

faq.q: Why is the badge dangerous in the hands of the Defias?
aliases: why does jack want the badge
faq.answer: With a genuine Marshal's badge and a disguised uniform, a Defias agent could impersonate high-ranking Stormwind officials to bypass sentries, infiltrate garrisons, or issue false orders to town guards.
Dead-tooth Jack locked the stolen badge inside his strongbox, stashed within his campsite located south of Marshal Haggard's farm in Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: Recovering Haggard's badge proves your mettle to a veteran of Stormwind's military, who rewards promising warriors with well-maintained surplus arms from his fighting days.
Retrieving the badge preserves the integrity of Stormwind's military command and prevents the Defias Brotherhood from sabotaging local defenses from within.
